summary.en: The halftone look: warm newsprint, one black plate and one process ink that prints only the anchor; every picture a procedural field printed as an AM screen; Bricolage Grotesque and IBM Plex Mono.
summary.zh: halftone 的样式：暖色新闻纸，一块黑版加一种只印锚点的印刷色；所有画面都是程序生成的场，用调幅网点印出；字体 Bricolage Grotesque 与 IBM Plex Mono。

fits: Launches of models and tools that want a printed, editorial feel with one recurring brand piece.
notFor: Screenshots and UI demos; films with several brand colours; photographic material.

intent.en: The film reads as printed: one black plate, one process ink kept for the brand piece, and every picture a field of dots that change size, never grey.
intent.zh: 整支片像印出来的：一块黑版，一种只留给品牌件的印刷色，所有画面都是只变大小、不变灰度的网点场。

content.en: A product mark with one separable piece (the anchor), four to six features each with a word.
content.zh: 一个能拆出一块（锚点）的产品标志，四到六个各配一个词的功能。

fits.zh: 想要印刷感、编辑感的模型和工具发布片，有一个反复出现的品牌件。

notFor.zh: 截图和界面演示；多种品牌色；照片素材。

en: The accent prints the anchor only: never type, a field or emphasis.
Bricolage Grotesque and IBM Plex Mono are not in tools/fonts.json: samples fall back to Inter Tight and JetBrains Mono.
zh: 强调色只印锚点：不印字、不印场、不做强调。
Bricolage Grotesque 与 IBM Plex Mono 不在 tools/fonts.json，小样回退到 Inter Tight 与 JetBrains Mono。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
